subject.title: chore(deps): bump actions/setup-node from 6.4.0 to 7.0.0 in the github-actions group

question: Should this major `actions/setup-node` upgrade merge after the existing matrix coverage, or should the Pages deployment and Crabbox hydration dispatch paths be directly exercised first?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow and normal CI passed, but whether indirect coverage is sufficient for the two specialized triggers is an operational acceptance decision rather than a code defect that can be safely inferred.

options.title: Run specialized workflow proof
options.body: Trigger or inspect successful Pages and Crabbox hydration runs using this head before merging the major action upgrade.

options.title: Accept existing coverage
options.body: Merge based on the successful cross-platform matrix while explicitly accepting that the specialized trigger paths were not directly demonstrated.
